one_liner: The 3 answers become 3 high-quality images, another Luzia+ perk.
author: aadi
from_run: kg-run-luzia-c05 (PR 5 round 6: runs/luzia/20260928-042747-6d79ef8-fixture/propose/candidates.json c05), edited: 3 high-quality images (paywall bullet l03, s02.e04) wherever the offer names its reward

candidate.title: Welcome-back card: try 3 high-quality images
candidate.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall (s02) lists 'Higher-quality image generations' (s02.e04) as a paid feature. A returning free user sees a one-day sample of 3 on the Chats home (s01), under the existing Luzia+ badge (s01.e02). The full feature stays behind the Weekly / Monthly / Annual plans and the 3-day trial (s02.e19).
candidate.trigger_event: First app open after 3 or more days with no session, by a user without Luzia+.
candidate.placement: A dismissible card under the Chats header, above the 'How can I help you today?' prompt card.
candidate.offer_copy: Welcome back! Play a short game to get 3 high-quality images today, a Luzia+ perk.
candidate.frequency_cap: 1 per day, resets at midnight local time; shown only on the first open after a 3+ day gap
candidate.decline_path: Tapping 'Not now' closes the card. Home works exactly as before, and the card does not return until the user's next gap of 3+ days.
candidate.ad_fail_path: If no game is available, the card is not shown. If the play isn't confirmed, a note says 'That game didn't count, try again'. The card stays and the day's offer is not used up.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: Never shown. Luzia+ members already have higher-quality images.
candidate.advertiser_category: Casual mobile games, streaming services, language and learning apps
candidate.character_use: Luzia's own avatar appears on the card, inviting the user back.

flow_steps.caption: A user who hasn't opened Luzia in 3+ days lands on Chats as usual.
A welcome-back card offers 3 high-quality images for a short game.
The user plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
The card changes to '3 high-quality images ready today.'

candidate.after_reward: When the 3 images are used or the day ends, a small note on Chats says Luzia+ keeps higher-quality images on every day and shows the 3-day free trial button.
candidate.rationale: A lapsing user needs a reason to open Luzia today. A day's sample of a paid feature they haven't tried is a fresh reason, and it doubles as a preview of Luzia+. Each image takes real generation time, so the cost line decides where it pays for itself.

economics.assumption_line: Costs ~$0.1020 per reward to serve; pays for itself above $102.00 eCPM. It is a sample of the paid benefit l03 "Higher-quality image generations", which stays on sale. A rewarded view earns $9.20-16.49 eCPM in North America on Android, $1.90 in LATAM. Assumes 3 images at $0.034 each (central price); one view per reward; a publisher-net eCPM (share 1).
